title: Ask HN: Anybody using their own AI harness as well?
excerpt: I started my first harness around this time last year, spent the last 8 months using other harnesses, about to go back to rewrite mine so I can use it from the learnings. Then I have another harness I've been working on to wrap an NES emulator and play FF1.
content_html:
I started my first harness around this time last year, spent the last 8 months using other harnesses, about to go back to rewrite mine so I can use it from the learnings. Then I have another harness I've been working on to wrap an NES emulator and play FF1.

We are so early into Ai, building a harness is a useful and educational experience.
